look_here_first: Relatively smooth leaves, strongly asymmetrical leaf base, unarmed tree habit, corky-warty bark.
synonyms: Celtis laevigata var. laevigata (historical nominate-variety treatment)
taxonomic_note: Current Kew POWO accepts Celtis laevigata at species rank. The B091 source row 'Celtis laevigata var. laevigata' is folded into this species-level canonical learner.

best_field_traits: upper surface smoother than netleaf hackberry
margins mostly entire or with few teeth
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with C. reticulata, sugarberry has thinner, smoother leaves with less prominently raised reticulate veins beneath. Compared with C. lindheimeri, leaf undersides are not densely white-tomentose.
